# MASA tooling

These two immutable local package archives contain MASA reference tooling 0.2.2.
Their record protocol and schema identifiers remain MASA 0.2.0. Validation is
offline and uses the embedded canonical resources.

`CHECKSUMS.sha256` identifies the exact archive bytes. `PROVENANCE.json` records
the current owner source digest and base commit. The candidate includes
uncommitted changes and has not been published. Historical 0.2.0 packages remain
under `vendor/masa/` for comparison and are excluded from current local archives.
